summary: Find a largest value with an explicit empty-input policy.
documentation: max selects the largest item of an iterable. The default keyword supplies a result when that iterable is empty; without a default an empty iterable raises ValueError. A key function can customize comparisons.
inputs: An iterable; optional default and comparison key.
returns: The largest item, or default for an empty iterable.
caution: default is for the single-iterable form. Comparing incompatible types can raise TypeError.
scenarios: Find the busiest hour from booking totals.
Pick the largest outstanding invoice amount.
Display a peak daily visitor count.
title: Find peak bookings
problem: Input is a list of nonnegative integer booking counts. Return the largest count, or 0 for an empty list.
goal: Use max() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Supply an explicit default for an empty iterable.
